verdict: Google spend doubled, leads fell — Meta is carrying results this period.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 23 tracked leads at an average cost per lead of $152.05, but the week-over-week picture shifted sharply: spend rose +89% while leads dropped -38%, pushing cost per lead up +208%. All 23 tracked leads came through Meta at roughly $45 each — Google Ads spent $2,462 this period and returned only 6 conversions at approximately $410 each, which confirms a serious efficiency problem on that channel. We are reviewing the Google Local Services campaign before adding any further budget there. Separately, your Google Business Profile activity fell -51% week-over-week and went quiet in the last three days of the window; we are monitoring that closely and expect to identify the cause this coming week.
